snippet.title: Calling All Villains - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
The #CallingAllVillains Pilot drops OCTOBER 31st. 
___________________________

Calling All Villains is a 3D animated sci-fi/action/comedy series produced and creatively helmed by ZAMination, starring Mr. Puzzles--originally from SMG4.

This isn’t a direct continuation of SMG4. Set years later, the series follows Mr. Puzzles as he’s evolved--for better or worse... roping him into all-new adventures with a brand new cast of characters. Haven't seen SMG4? No problem! Calling All Villains is built as a fresh starting point, so you can jump right in and enjoy the ride. And for longtime fans, there are plenty of hidden nods and juicy Easter eggs waiting for you...

snippet.title: 10-Month-Old Baby JOINS my violin street performance
snippet.description:
While I was playing “I Want to Know What Love Is” by Foreigner on my violin, the sweetest little surprise happened! 🎻❤️

An adorable 10-month-old baby came over to listen to the music, watched me with so much curiosity, and even started dancing! 🥹❤️ It was such a precious moment, and I’m so happy I got to share it with you.

I love how music can bring joy to people of all ages, even the tiniest listeners! 🎶

What did you think of this sweet little music lover? Let me know in the comments! 😊

Thank you so much for watching and supporting my music!

You can support me by streaming or getting my music here! 👇

hep uzaklara dalmaktan.
Dillerim çok suskun yine,
hep içime atmaktan.

nasıl dayanırım?

cevapsız sorular.

snippet.title: Grand Theft Auto VI Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Vice City, USA. Jason and Lucia have always known the deck is stacked against them. But when an easy score goes wrong, they find themselves on the darkest side of the sunniest place in America, in the middle of a criminal conspiracy stretching across the state of Leonida — forced to rely on each other more than ever if they want to make it out alive.

Check out the new Launch Trailer, featuring new music from electronic duo Justice, composers of the original score from Grand Theft Auto VI. 

The new standalone Justice single, “Flower in a Hurricane” feat. Tame Impala, SZA, and King Gizzard & The Lizard Wizard, is also available on Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album, the official soundtrack which is currently available to pre-save on all major music streaming services and up for pre-order on vinyl or CD.

Grand Theft Auto VI arrives November 19.

snippet.title: This perk is 100% getting nerfed, isn't it...
snippet.description:
Secret Project was a strong perk when it released but recently it has become an even stronger after perks such as Undone and Thrilling Tremors got buffed. This type of build stalls gens, counters boons and can make any Killer really stealthy. The ratio of easy to use / hard to play against is so off the charts that I genuinely think this build could really take off and possibly get nerfed in the future.

snippet.title: LOOK WHAT I FOUND!! | Beans and Alpacas FS25 - Episode 6
snippet.description:
This is the early access version sent to me for free from Giants Software.
Order now! - https://www.farming-simulator.com/dlc-detail.php?dlc_id=fs25beansandalpacas&code=DAGGERWIN

Build your coffee estate and grow a warmer kind of farm life in the Beans & Alpacas Expansion: Travel to Catuaí, a South America-inspired region where coffee plantations cover rolling hills, red soil shapes the land and dense greenery stretches across lower mountain slopes. New crops, animals, production chains and more than 25 new machines await.

Catuaí: Welcome to South America!
Explore a lush, humid valley with narrow roads, dusty streets, scattered rocks and a winding river running through the landscape. A small rural town with colorful buildings, shops and agricultural depots connects the region, while stilt houses line the river shore.

Coffee, Animals & New Gameplay
Cultivate coffee beans as a new crop and expand your livestock with alpacas and Brahman cows. Alpacas add new hands-on interaction through shearing and leading, while wild animals like crocodiles and parrots bring more life to the environment.

Productions, Projects & Collectibles
Create new products such as pigment and resin, and repaint houses for the community, or start production chains for crop processing. Take on the Research Center construction project, find dinosaur skeleton parts and collect your discoveries in the collectible museum.

Machines, Brands & Details
Operate 25+ new machines from Case IH, Ford, John Deere, KUHN, Mercedes-Benz Trucks, New Holland, Valtra, and many more. Colombo Industries joins the series as a new brand, while enhanced ground tool animations and improved effects increase immersion.

Music by Epidemic Sound

Each player is also given their own piece of undeveloped real estate along with a virtual toolbox with which to design and build anything — be it a navigable skyscraper, a working helicopter, a giant pinball machine, a multiplayer “Capture the Flag” game, or some other, yet-to-be-dreamed-up creation. In turn, they can shop the online catalog to purchase avatar clothing and accessories as well as premium building materials, interactive components, and working mechanisms. Roblox is a global platform where millions of people gather together every day to imagine, create, and share experiences with each other in immersive, user-generated 3D worlds. Welcome to THE HOTZONE: THE OFFICIAL WARDOGS PODCAST | Episode 1.

Joe, Executive Producer on WARDOGS and Studio Lead, is joined by Pete (Lead Designer), Mark (Technical Designer) and Tim (Creative Director) to react to the initial reception of WARDOGS Season 2.

From what went right to what went wrong with our first first wipe in Early Access. The team digs into some of the key data, discusses the biggest lessons so far and share their thoughts on what lies ahead.
